en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm river or canal with a low stone bridge and sluice/lock structure. There are three arches in the bridge and a wooden footbridge or gate on top. On the right bank stands a large white rural building with a dark roof, reflected in the still water. Trees and foliage frame the left side of the image, and there is a small wooden plank or jetty in the foreground by the water. Handwritten notes in dark ink appear over the image, likely in a Central or Eastern European language.
